newsitem.title: USA: Medicaid item among likely line-item vetos - NYT.
newsitem.headline: Medicaid item among likely line-item vetos - NYT.

text.p: A particular change in the Medicaid program that the Clinton Administration considers flawed policy is among likely candidates to be killed by the president's line-item veto of the new balanced budget, the New York Times reported, citing congressional officials.

Also a candidate to be cut: a provision worth an estimated $84 million over five years that would allow the deferral of taxes for the sale of a food-processing plant to farmers' cooperatives, the paper said on Monday.
Clinton will exercise his line-item veto authority for the first time today, by deleting the two items from the balanced-budget and tax-cut legislation he signed last week, the paper said.
